techniques.comment: S02: fixed Python callback creates a harmless marker during unpickling. S03: callback and marker occur before EOFError. Both are in-process benign emulations. Parent T1059 is not counted as a second tested technique. Supply-chain delivery, shell execution and C2 are not tested.
